title: 第一百五十六章龙钟君的阴谋第一百五十五章斩杀安家老祖
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: “从今天开始，安家不得有炼虚期以上的强者，如有违背，本座必定前来血洗一番！”
李长寿飞向虚空的声音犹如阎王宣誓。
无数血色符文从天而降，打入安家每一个人的身上。
安家族人一个个蜷缩着身子，发出一声声痛苦的哀嚎。
随着这枚符文和安家族人融合，他们修为皆是在这一刻骤降。
渡劫期，合体期，炼虚期，全都降落到了化神期巅峰。
体内的经脉就强行施加禁锢，始终有一道破不开的枷锁。
“万魂宗的邪术果然好用，这样便可免去后顾之忧。”
李长寿心中呢喃一句，将安百灵拖入尊魂幡，收了安家宝库，消失在天际。
回到李府，李长寿便把安百灵像是拖死狗一样丢在地上。
安如雪看到此人，眼中满是杀机。
“你...小雪，好久不见，我是姨娘啊！”
安百灵感受到杀气，不顾狼狈，脸上强行挤出一丝欢笑。
“姨娘？”
“从小让我受尽白眼，挖骨伤害我的姨娘？”
安如雪神色淡漠，手中多出一把寒冰利刃，轻轻一挥。
咔嚓！
安百灵一条手臂被硬生生斩了下来，鲜血淋漓的落在地上。
“不，你不能这么对我，我只是为了咱们安家变得更强，我没有错！”
安百灵痛苦地哽咽，说出的话疼得都破音了。
安如雪看到残害她的毒妇疼成这样，没有半分怜悯，有的只是舒爽。
“安家变得更强，为什么要给你那废物儿子？”
“还是说，挖了我的骨，将我丢弃，是我的错了？”
咔嚓！
又一条手臂被利刃斩杀。
安百灵自知已经活不成了，愤怒的嘶吼：“对，这一切都是你的错，都是你的光芒太盛，让我的天才儿子的光芒变得暗淡。”
“若是你没有那块骨，我也不会对你下手。”
“哈哈哈！现在我的夫君一脉的人都死了，你是安家的罪人，你罪该万死！”
安如雪看了一眼旁边的李长寿，颇为感动。
这么多年了，夫君始终还记得这件事。
他原以为报仇至少得两百年之后，待她突破到大乘期才能够做到。
“谢谢你，夫君。”
咔！
一声轻柔的感谢，安百灵的头颅如断头台般飞了过去，落在了地上。
鲜血洒落一地，很快就变得干涸，痕迹抹除，仿佛她从来没有死过。
“这件事我一直都记得。”李长寿挥手抓住安百灵的灵魂，又将安逸的灵魂从尊魂幡中召唤了出来，放在一枚玉瓶中递了过去。
“多年的仇怨已报，要是觉得还不解气，那就蹂躏他们吧！”
安逸灵魂，安百灵灵魂：你们清高，把幸福建立在我们痛苦之上。
“谢谢夫君。”
安如雪扑在李长寿怀中，感激地吻了上去。
其他夫人们早就听到了动静，全程了观战。

"From today on, the An family is not allowed to have any strong people above the Void Refining Stage. If there is any violation, I will definitely come and give you a bloodbath!"
The sound of Li Changshou flying into the void was like the oath of the King of Hell.
Countless bloody runes fell from the sky and penetrated into the bodies of everyone in the An family.
The An family members curled up one by one and let out painful wails.
As this rune merged with the An family members, their cultivation levels plummeted at this moment.
The Tribulation Transcendence Stage, the Integration Stage, and the Void Refining Stage have all reached the peak of the God Transformation Stage.
The meridians in the body are forcibly imprisoned, and there is always a shackle that cannot be broken.
"The Wanhun Sect's evil spells are really easy to use, so you won't have to worry about anything in the future."
Li Changshou murmured in his heart, dragged An Bailing into the Zunhun Banner, collected the An family's treasure house, and disappeared into the sky.
...
Back at Li Mansion, Li Changshou threw An Bailing to the ground like a dog dragged to death.
When An Ruxue saw this man, her eyes were filled with murderous intent.
"You...Xiaoxue, long time no see, I'm your aunt!"
An Baelin felt the murderous intent, and despite his embarrassment, he forced a smile on his face.
"Aunt?"
"The aunt who made me look down on me all the time, dug out my bones and hurt me since I was a child?"
An Ruxue looked indifferent, and there was an ice blade in her hand, and she waved it lightly.
Click!
One of An Bailing's arms was chopped off abruptly, and it fell to the ground dripping with blood.
"No, you can't do this to me. I just want to become stronger for our Anjia. I'm not wrong!"
An Bailing choked in pain, and the words he spoke were so painful that his voice broke.
When An Ruxue saw the vicious woman who tortured her in such pain, she didn't feel any pity, but felt relieved.
"The An family has become stronger, why did they give you that good-for-nothing son?"
"Or is it my fault that you dug up my bones and threw me away?"
Click!
Another arm was killed by a sharp blade.
An Bailing knew that he was not going to survive, so he roared angrily: "Yes, this is all your fault. It's all because you shine so brightly that your genius son's shine dims."
"If you didn't have that bone, I wouldn't attack you."
"Hahaha! Now everyone in my husband's lineage is dead. You are the sinner of the An family. You deserve death!"
An Ruxue glanced at Li Changshou next to her and was quite moved.
After so many years, my husband still remembers this incident.
He originally thought that revenge would take at least two hundred years before she could achieve it until she broke through to the Mahayana stage.
"Thank you, husband."
Click!
With a soft thank you, An Bailing's head flew over like a guillotine and landed on the ground.
The blood spilled all over the floor, and soon dried up, and the traces were erased, as if she had never died.
"I will always remember this." Li Changshou waved his hand and grabbed An Bailing's soul, summoned An Yi's soul from the soul banner, put it in a jade bottle and handed it over.
"Years of grudges have been avenged. If you still feel unsatisfied, then ravage them!"
Comfortable soul, An Bailing soul: You are noble and noble, and you build happiness on our pain.
"Thank you, husband."
An Ruxue threw herself into Li Changshou's arms and kissed him gratefully.
The other ladies had already heard the news and watched the entire battle.
